div.p: “Tales of the Sun” / photographs by Robert Scott Tait (RST) assembled and bound into a presentation album by Geraldine Jewsbury (GEJ) / this volume with its laid in addenda includes 39 images / the title page is dated 1855, but numerous images are from two years later
